item.description:
Astronomical 0.2.48
Thin Talk
- Conversation answers now render on a local web canvas with mathematics (KaTeX), diagrams, and code highlighting; all rendering assets ship inside the application. - A thinking-effort control lets you tune answer quality per turn. - Conversations launch directly from the menu bar, and every turn stays readable while the conversation continues.
Chat
- Fixed a rejection that stopped an entire chat thread before generation when a declared tool property used a schema with three or more `anyOf` branches. Local model serving now accepts any branch count, and if a tool declaration is still unsupported, the reason shown names the offending tool and property instead of an opaque parser message.
Compatibility
- Requires macOS 14.0 or newer on Apple silicon (arm64). - Installs in place through Sparkle; existing configuration, model stores, and caches are preserved.
This release is signed with the Developer ID Application identity, notarized by Apple, and the stapled application is Sparkle-signed before distribution.
